notes.coordinates: Representative locations for area weather lookups, not navigation waypoints. Coordinate provenance is recorded for each spot.
notes.recommendations: Rig choices are general suggestions inferred from fishing access and TPWD technique guidance. They are not reports of current catches or predictions of fishing success.
notes.conditions: Fetch current weather separately. This file contains no live weather, tides, water temperatures, or closure status.
notes.access: Use each visitor information page for current access details, fees, and alerts.

spots.name: Cole Park Pier
spots.coordinateNote: TCEQ monitoring station named for Cole Park Pier; published in NAD83 with no stated accuracy. Used as an approximate weather location, not the pier entrance.
spots.description: A city fishing pier on Corpus Christi Bay with seating, lights, rod holders, and fish-cleaning facilities.

access.location: Cole Park, Ocean Drive, Corpus Christi, Texas
access.summary: Walk onto the pier from Cole Park. Visit Corpus Christi lists pier access as free.

tips: For a general trout setup, try shrimp beneath a popping cork and adjust the bait depth and retrieve.
When targeting fish feeding near the bottom, consider a bottom rig instead.

spots.name: Mustang Island State Park
spots.coordinateNote: Park location published by TPWD. This represents the park, not a specific beach casting position or bayside launch.
spots.waterBody: Gulf coast and Corpus Christi Bay
spots.description: A coastal state park with beach fishing and bayside paddling trails through shallow fishing areas.

access.summary: Use the park's visitor information and maps to choose beach access or a bayside paddling route. Day-use entry fees apply, and TPWD recommends reservations because the park can reach capacity.

tips: For surf fishing, a bottom rig with shrimp is a general starting option.
For shallow bayside fishing, consider shrimp under a popping cork.
Where vegetation catches exposed hooks, a weedless spoon is an option for targeting red drum.

spots.name: Bird Island Basin Day-use Area
spots.coordinateNote: Day-use area coordinates published by the National Park Service. The motorboat ramp is a separate site.
spots.description: A Laguna Madre access point within Padre Island National Seashore for fishing and launching paddle craft from the shoreline.

access.location: Bird Island Basin, Padre Island National Seashore, Texas
access.summary: The day-use area has gravel parking and shoreline access for paddle craft. Motorboats use the separate Bird Island Basin Boat Ramp.

tips: Try shrimp under a popping cork as a general shallow-water setup for trout or red drum.
Consider a weedless spoon when targeting red drum around submerged or floating vegetation.
A bottom rig is another option when targeting black drum.

spots.name: Indian Point Pier
spots.coordinateNote: Published pier coordinates from a third-party coordinate directory; used as an approximate area weather location.
spots.description: A fishing pier in Portland with fish-cleaning stations and a picnic area at Indian Point Park.

access.location: Indian Point Park, Highway 181, Portland, Texas
access.summary: Access the pier from Indian Point Park. The city's parks directory lists the park and pier as open around the clock; check for local notices before visiting.

tips: For trout, try shrimp under a popping cork and vary the bait depth.
Consider shrimp on a bottom rig when targeting black drum.

spots.name: Philip Dimmitt Municipal Pier
spots.coordinateNote: Converted from Fishbrain's published 27 degrees 40 minutes 10.4 seconds N, 97 degrees 16 minutes 10.4 seconds W. Third-party approximate weather location.
spots.description: A municipal fishing pier in Flour Bluff with lighting, benches, and fish-cleaning stations.

access.location: Jester Street, Flour Bluff, Corpus Christi, Texas
access.summary: Visit Corpus Christi lists this municipal pier as free to use.

tips: Try shrimp beneath a popping cork for trout, adjusting the depth to the water you are fishing.
A bottom rig offers an alternative presentation for fish feeding near the bottom.

spots.name: Packery Channel Nature Park
spots.coordinateNote: Converted from the shoreline project's published site coordinates: 27 degrees 37 minutes 41.49 seconds N, 97 degrees 13 minutes 1.73 seconds W. Represents the park shoreline, not the Gulf jetties.
spots.description: A park on the Laguna Madre side of North Padre Island with shoreline fishing access and kayak launch areas.

access.location: Packery Channel Nature Park, North Padre Island, Corpus Christi, Texas
access.summary: Use the park's shoreline access or kayak launches. This is separate from the Gulf-side Packery Channel jetties. Check county notices for access changes associated with shoreline improvements.

tips: For shallow-water fishing, try shrimp under a popping cork.
Consider a weedless spoon where vegetation interferes with exposed hooks.
Use a bottom rig when you want to present bait near the bottom.

rigs.name: Popping cork with shrimp
rigs.description: Suspend shrimp below a cork. Periodically pop the cork, then pause; vary the bait depth and retrieve.
rigs.useWhen: A general option for shallow bay or lagoon fishing.

rigs.name: Bottom rig with shrimp
rigs.description: Use a sinker and a hook on a dropper to present bait near the bottom.
rigs.useWhen: A general option for bank or surf fishing, or when fish are feeding near the bottom.

rigs.name: Weedless spoon
rigs.description: A shallow-running artificial lure with a guarded hook for fishing around vegetation.
rigs.useWhen: Consider for red drum on grass flats, especially where vegetation interferes with exposed hooks.
